paper.title_en: Asymptotically Anti-de Sitter Spherically Symmetric Hairy Black Holes
paper.abstract_en: We construct one-parameter families of static spherically symmetric asymptotically anti-de Sitter black hole solutions $(\mathcal{M},g_ε,φ_ε)$ to the Einstein-Maxwell-(charged) Klein-Gordon equations. Each family bifurcates off a sub-extremal Reissner-Nordström-AdS spacetime $(\mathcal{M},g_{0},φ_{0}\equiv0)$. For a co-dimensional one set of black hole parameters, we show that Dirichlet (respectively Neumann) boundary conditions can be imposed for the scalar field. The construction provides a counter-example to a version of the no-hair conjecture in the context of a negative cosmological constant. Our result is based on our companion work [W. Zheng, \emph{Exponentially-growing Mode Instability on the Reissner-Nordström-Anti-de-Sitter black holes}], in which the existence of linear hair and growing mode solutions has been established. In the charged scalar field case, our result provides the first rigorous mathematical construction of the so-called holographic superconductors, which are of particular significance in high-energy physics.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文构造了爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦-(带电)克莱因-戈登方程的一参数族静态球对称渐近反德西特带毛黑洞解，为负宇宙学常数情形下的无毛猜想提供了反例，并首次严格数学构造了所谓全息超导体，理论深度和与全息凝聚态物理的关联性均较强。
decision.title_zh: 渐近反德西特球对称带毛黑洞
decision.abstract_zh: 我们构造了爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦-(带电)克莱因-戈登方程的一参数族静态球对称渐近反德西特黑洞解 $(\mathcal{M},g_ε,φ_ε)$。每个族从次极端 Reissner-Nordström-AdS 时空 $(\mathcal{M},g_{0},φ_{0}\equiv0)$ 分岔出来。对于余维度为一的黑洞参数集，我们证明可以对标量场施加 Dirichlet（分别地 Neumann）边界条件。该构造在负宇宙学常数的背景下为无毛猜想的一个版本提供了反例。我们的结果基于我们的姊妹工作 [W. Zheng, \emph{Exponentially-growing Mode Instability on the Reissner-Nordström-Anti-de-Sitter black holes}]，其中线性毛和增长模解的存在性已被建立。在带电标量场情形下，我们的结果为所谓的全息超导体提供了首个严格的数学构造，这些全息超导体在高能物理中具有特别重要的意义。
